notes.title: Aeloren Tactics Surprise Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295146/f272b8970370e1914ca791374bc3fcd72dde5bbe.png

Surprise update for Aeloren Tactics!

This update wasn't supposed to happen, but I figured that it should. I hope those of you who have played Aeloren Tactics or are thinking about playing it, end up enjoying it. Thanks and enjoy!

Here is what is new:

-Gave Felix, Haru and Lysithia, Limit Breaks.

-Fixed some Limit Breaks that were supposed to appear
with certain characters during specific maps.

-Added in two brand new characters; Pip Longfellow, the Wyvern Tamer, who fights alongside his Wyvern and best friend; Verta. Also added in Nia Harro, the Witch. (Basically a stronger Yuna from Falnarion Tactics II).

-Added in a new side quest; The Peak. This is where you
can recruit the two new characters and fight new enemies
as well as the mighty Wyvern.

-Changed some of the dialogue in the opening credits scene.

-Fixed some of the bio descriptions and added in two new
bios for the new characters.

-Added in two more memory fragments in the Item Shop.

-Added in the Armada. A sword that is strong against armor
and ignores defense. Can be found in the Sword Shop and
Special Shop.

I know it's not much, but it's something. Anyways, please enjoy this new update and if you want more Tactics games as well as other types of games from Team Syukino, please check out the store page and follow it for news about current, old and new projects. Also look out for Pixel Boy: The Legend of Tain, Estellium Legends II and Exiori! More info can be found on Itch.io and in the future on the Team Syukino store page!

https://syukino.itch.io/
https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/TeamSyukino

notes.title: Aeloren Tactics Final Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295146/fb68a5440e592bd46bcd4869d482ae787c1843aa.png
Aeloren Tactics Final Update.
This update was not supposed to happen, but I thought I'd do it anyways.

So here is what is new:


-Added in a new side quest; The Emperor (Not for low levels).

-Added in Algorium (The main villian from Falnarion Tactics).
He is recrutiable in the side quest; The Emperor as a playable character.

-Added in two original songs from the Euclyca OST for "The Emperor" side quest.
"Fateful Encounter" and "At Odds".

-Added in two new Sword-Type weapons; Mage Killer and the Rashindo
(Mitsu's weapon from Euclyca).

*Fixed a few grammar issues and some tiny errors.

Also the donation DLC will be leaving Steam January 1st 2021. Thank you all who
helped fund these continuous and spontaneous updates by purchasing the DLC.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1410130/Aeloren_Tactics_Bandit_Princess_Donation/

notes.title: Aeloren Tactics v1.3 Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295146/fb68a5440e592bd46bcd4869d482ae787c1843aa.png

Aeloren Tactics v1.3 update.

This is the last update for Aeloren Tactics and will put the finishing touches
on the final product.

Of course from v1.0 the game was fully finished, but free updates with new content
doesn't hurt.

Anyways here is what is new:


-Added in a new weapon called Rock Smasher (Axe).

-Added in a new character; Flynn Ortello. He is an Axe wielder.

-Added in some more extra content in the extras section.

-Added in a glossary in the extras section which is more like a journal entry
than an actual glossary in this case. It is written from the perspective of
a certain character.

-Fixed Lysithia's missing dialogue lines from falling in combat.

-Fixed some things here and there.

-Added in two new side quests; Chaos Dragon Lair and Army of Bandits.

-Added in a brand new enemy type; Land Fish.

-Added in some small hidden goodies.


I know that is has been rapid update after another, but the game is finished. So
for those of you who make those tier lists, now is the time.

Thank you all and I hope you enjoy Aeloren Tactics!

notes.title: Aeloren Tactics v1.2 update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295146/fb68a5440e592bd46bcd4869d482ae787c1843aa.png

Hello and welcome to another update of Aeloren Tactics!

Aeloren Tactics v1.2

Here is what is new:


-Added in 3 new side quests; Conquest II, Desert Mission II and The Way.

-Added in 1 new side character; Lysithia the Gun Angel.

-Added Extras with character bios, sound room and gallery.

-Added in gun type weapons with a gun shop. (Pistol, Shotgun, SMG and Sniper Rifle).

-Added in a new Axe (Flambraken), Sword (Oracle Blade), Spear (Spear of Sages),
 Bow (Heartseeker Bow) and Tome (Yentin) weapon.

-Added in One Man Army mode.

-A bunch of items added to the bonus shop.

-A hidden goodie.


That is all for now!

notes.title: Aeloren Tactics v1.1 update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295146/fb68a5440e592bd46bcd4869d482ae787c1843aa.png

Welcome to Aeloren Tactics v1.1 update!


Let's waste no time and show you what is new!


-Added in an extra item/weapon slot for each character in battle. (Max is four)!

-Removed some enemies in the prologue chapter and in chapter three.

-Added in two more green units in the prologue mission.

-Nerfed beast weapons slightly.

-Added in a brief skill explanation + other things in the prologue
chapter and in the information section of the base camp menu.

-Fixed some of the story dialogue at the start of the introduction scrolling text.

-In the side quests; The Elf, The Mage and The Slacker. The ally units can fall in combat
and you will no longer get a game over and will still be able to recruit them like
in the Falnarion Tactics series. (The Elf is Faye from Falnarion Tactics II).

-There is a new easy side quest called; Conquest.

-Clairena has obtained a minor buff to stats (May not affect your current play-through).

-Some units have additional starting items/weapons at the start of a new game.

-A new weapon has been added into the game; Justice Lance.
It is available at the start of a new game with Clairena and in the Special Shop. 

-A tutorial has been added in the start of the game and can be viewed in the information
section in the base camp menu at any time.

This game is made to be a bit more challenging than the Falnarion Tactics series, still I'd want it to be enjoyable. Anyways if you are a fan of SRPGs and would like to play similar games in this genre made/published by Team Syukino.

Please check out Falnarion Tactics I and II as well as Tales of Beasteria.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/974180/Falnarion_Tactics/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1078450/Falnarion_Tactics_II/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203030/Tales_of_Beasteria/
